name: Celestia: Chain of Fate
source: On my coming-of-age celebration, my whole life suddenly changed. My family revealed a truth that I could've never imagined. Magic, Angels, Demons. They're all real? On top of that, I have to face it all in a Magical Academy!
translation: 在我的成年庆典上，我的整个生活突然发生了变化。我的家人揭露了一个我从未想象过的真相。魔法、天使、恶魔。都是真的吗？而且，我还要在魔法学院里面对这一切！
